private_policy_additions: START needs 1..6 distinct owned partner ids (getFormationStr leaves rented girls out); a formation with no owned girl is refused.

RESULT total_damage is the client's harm sum and may be fractional; it is truncated to an integer before bounding (0..1e15). conquer_lev, conquer_loop_id, conquer_region and awards are answered only on promotion, because the client re-enters chat rooms whenever conquer_lev is present.

A kept report snapshots the owner's directory card (name, level, avatar, frame, logical server as region, the post-settlement conquer_lev/conquer_loop_id) and the formation's MID1 roster rows and pet row at RESULT time; it never changes afterwards.
1572 answers report.report as the stored replay JSON text (ConquerSchoolReportWindow json.decodes it). Reading a report needs no function gate; viewing one's own report never rewards.
The view reward mail is one mail per rewarded view (source key report:viewer:day, CONQUER_SCHOOL_MAIL_TEXT with count 1, sender CONQUER_SCHOOL_MAIL_NAME, 50000 mana).
deviations_from_plan: The open attempt lives in the mode row (state.attempt) instead of a conquer_school_attempts table: there is at most one open attempt per player, a newer START supersedes it, and settled attempts survive as the facts origin_ref, the RESULT receipt and the kept report's attempt_id.
conquer_school_report_views has no rewarded column: only a first (report, viewer, day) view can reward, and the owner's report_award_times plus the mail record carry the outcome.
The function 48 gate reads the I5 function eligibility fact (as Top Floor does) instead of the directory level.
The Conquer School routes register with the other I7C-5 mode routes when GXB_COMBAT_ENTROPY_KEYS is configured: the mode itself starts no Combat attempt, but it reads the same MID1 roster composers.
The I7C-2J API test no longer expects 501 for 1568-1573/2790 (activated by this stage).
5D hygiene defect repaired: the 48 MB gxb-api binary committed in 106e65e is untracked and ignored.
known_limitations: BUY_CONQUER_TIMES reads the shared I5 privilege snapshot, whose provider reports MonthlyPrivilegeActive false until a monthly card owner exists (same limit as Top Floor and 1 on 1 purchases), so 2790 is refused in practice.
SystemBroadcast 3005, the conquer_school_ratio/conquer_school_reward tables and MID1 privilege_left_card_day stay unactivated.
Enemy scaling by loop ratio and the battle itself are client-side (CLIENT_SUMMARY_ATTESTED); the server bounds and recomputes consequences only.
lock_order: actor fence 315 -> I4 player root (2J PrepareWriteTx) -> Conquer facts row -> Conquer mode row -> I5 mail 610 / values 700+ -> directory 740; report view: viewer fence 315 -> view row -> owner mode row -> owner mail 610.
